title.zh-CN: 曼哈顿悬日的日出日期

prompt.zh-CN: 曼哈顿悬日随日出出现的日期通常在以下哪些时候附近？
prompt.en-US: Around which of these dates does Manhattanhenge occur with sunrise?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 A 和 D。5 月下旬和 7 月中旬通常对应日落方向的曼哈顿悬日；1 月和 12 月的日期对应日出方向。
reveal.en-US: The answers are A and D. Late May and mid-July are usually associated with sunset Manhattanhenge, while January and December dates correspond to sunrise alignment.
